newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares take a breather, end slightly off.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares take a breather, end slightly off.

text.p: Brazilian shares ended slightly off as investors took profits on Telebras stock after its strong rise at the open, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 47 most active shares fell 0.06 percent, closing at 13,609 points. Market turnover was 1.369 billion reais ($1.27 billion).
Shares of Telebras and its main subsidiaries surged early in the session following Wednesday's announcement of a higher-than-expected result for the Sao Paulo Band B bidding process.
A group led by BellSouth Corp paid 2.6 billion reais for a contract to operate cellular services in the Sao Paulo metropolitan area, considered the most lucrative of the 10 regional areas on offer.

The price was well above the minimum price of 600 million reais asked by the government and much higher than estimated by analysts, who thought the winning bid would be of a maximum 2.2 billion reais.
Telebras, which jumped over two percent earlier, ended off 0.69 percent at 173 reais, after trading at 180 reais.
But stocks of Telebras' operators posted significant rises, despite the late profit-taking. while Telerj soared 6.15 percent to close at 172.50 reais.
Telemig preferred rose 0.46 percent, ending at 195.90 reais.

Analysts said the result of the Band B cellular selloff in Sao Paulo indicated that investors will be willing to pay much more for Telebras and its units, Telesp in particular, when it is put up for sale in the near future.
Preferred stocks of Brazilian airlines TAM plunged 11.72 percent to 56.50 reais following Wednesday's accident in which one passenger was killed and six other injured.
Also, some experts think that the high bid will serve as a benchmark for the sale of Band A concessions, when they are offered to investors after the Band B process is completed.
While most of telecom stocks ended the session with rises, blue-chips from the power, mining and oil sectors posted losses.
Federal power holding Eletrobras fell 0.26 percent to 773 reais, oil firm Petrobras lost 0.91 percent to end at 325 reais and private miner CVRD fell 2.61 percent to 29.90 reais.
